violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The hand-washing sink in the bathroom was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink in the dishwashing area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Raw animal foods (such as egg and pork) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as produce) in the 3 door refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw items. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was less than 100 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. Inspector observed quat dispenser not dispensing enough sanitizer. PIC used chlorine instead. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Per interview with PIC, establishment washes and rinses meat cutting equipment (ban saw, grinder, shredder, and slicer) and the end of the day, but does not sanitize. The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. PIC informed and washed/sanitized items on site during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Ground beef, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Chicken wings were observed held at 112 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Crushed garlic was observed held at 63 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed item in cooler for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC labeled bottles. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Inspector observed ground beef stored in the walk-in refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep that was still cooling from the day before. PIC informed of proper cooling methods and discarded item. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The door to the outside, located at receiving (outside door to basement), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Various items were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
Inspector observed dry ingredients stored in non-food safe plastic totes. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Plastic deli containers are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Wood is used in the construction of meat shredder in the meat cutting area (wood held blade in place). Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. PIC disposed of wood items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The following was observed in poor repair: - sanitizer dispenser (not dispensing enough quat sanitizer) - meat display cooler #2 (ambient temp of 46F) - PIC called cooler company on site. Per PIC, should be here today by 2:00pm. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat and chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sinks. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - basement shelves - walk-in cooler racks - 3 door kitchen cooler - meat cutter/deli display coolers - kitchen shelves New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The condensate from basement office AC unit is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. PIC closed lid. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arrranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/29/2024

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 03/11/2024
